payload.author: experimental_development
payload.hypothesis: A compact transformer with convolutional tokenization (4x4 patches, 49 tokens) will outperform linear-embedding ViTs on 28x28 histopathology because the conv stem captures local nuclear morphology and texture patterns that are critical for distinguishing visually confusable tissue classes (background/debris/mucus, smooth muscle/stroma, normal mucosa/adenocarcinoma). The 49-token sequence length provides sufficient spatial resolution for attention to model inter-cellular relationships while remaining short enough to avoid overfitting on ~90k samples. Hidden width 128 with depth 4 balances capacity against the limited spatial information in 28x28 inputs.
